instruction: Navigate to slide 3 and change the font color of all text in the second textbox to green.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font color to green (RGB: 0, 255, 0) for all text in slide 3, shape 4. Evaluator checks if all text runs have the exact green color applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic flaw: Getter only verifies all text has consistent color, but doesn't handle empty textboxes (returns None) or text runs without explicit rgb attributes
The getter skips text runs that don't have 'run.font.color.rgb' attribute - these may inherit default colors, leading to incomplete verification
If textbox is empty or all runs lack explicit color, getter returns None causing false failure (metric returns 0.0)
Instruction requires verifying 'all text' is green, but getter doesn't check if there's actually text present or count how many runs were verified
Shape index assumption: 'second textbox' = shape_index 4 may be incorrect depending on slide structure (title placeholders, other shapes)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter should explicitly check if textbox has any text content, return appropriate value for empty case
Handle text runs without explicit rgb attribute - either check inherited color or document that only explicit colors are verified
Add validation that at least one text run was found and checked (avoid returning None for empty iterations)
Consider verifying shape type to ensure shape_index 4 is actually a textbox
Add logic to handle edge cases: empty textbox, text with default/inherited colors, mixed explicit/implicit color formatting
